mapper.select: SELECT id, concept_id, user_id, role, content, tool_name, tool_args::text AS tool_args, form_snapshot::text AS form_snapshot, tokens_in, tokens_out, created_at FROM concept_draft_session WHERE concept_id = #{conceptId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO concept_draft_session (id, concept_id, user_id, role, content, tool_name, tool_args, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{conceptId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{toolName}, CAST(#{toolArgs} AS jsonb), now())
